planets.name: TOI-1472 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1472 with a 6.36-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1472 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1472. Its orbit and size follow Carleo et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
